integrity: Analytic proof and independently executable symbolic identity checker; finite numerical experiments are illustrative, not a proof of quantified statements.
limitations: The double-logarithmic first-passage estimate is for x0=3/5, mu=2, epsilon approaching epsilon_star from above; exact switch landings stay at one half. Not an ensemble mean or a universal rate. The 1993 sectional-discontinuity full text was not accessible; priority uncertainty remains. No independent verification.
title: Superattracting border collision and a double-logarithmic extinction clock in a dispersal map
